name: jarvis-mvp
description: macOS menu-bar mission control for Claude Code and Codex sessions: status panel, notifications, voice (Rust + Tauri)

scripts.start: npm run build:agent-vm-plugin && JARVIS_DEV_SIGN=1 cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features wakeword-ort,whisper-native,stt-vad --bin jarvis && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements src-tauri/entitlements.plist src-tauri/target/release/jarvis && JARVIS_DIR="$HOME/.jarvis-dev" JARVIS_DEV=1 JARVIS_PLUGIN_DEV_DIR="$PWD/plugins" src-tauri/target/release/jarvis
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:agent-vm-plugin && JARVIS_DEV_SIGN=1 cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features wakeword-ort,whisper-native,stt-vad --bin jarvis && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements src-tauri/entitlements.plist src-tauri/target/release/jarvis && src-tauri/target/release/jarvis
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path plugins/agent-vm/Cargo.toml
scripts.generate:plugin-contracts: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path crates/jarvis-plugin-protocol/Cargo.toml --bin export_ui_contracts && node scripts/generate-plugin-ui-contracts.mjs
